NoTarget.label: Add gizmo "No Target" to hostile pawns
NoTarget.description: When toggled on, the pawn will be temporarily (duration adjustable, defaults to 1 day) marked as "No Target", preventing colonists and turrets from auto-targeting them. Forced attacks ignore this mark. Hostile pawns with positive relations with colonists will be automatically marked as "No Target". Additionally, if the positive relation is a family relation, the mark will be permanent until manually removed.

CaptureAsJob.label: Add gizmo "Capture" to capturable pawns
CaptureAsJob.description: When toggled on, the pawn will be marked as available for capture. Colonists assigned with warden jobs will capture them automatically.

AutoNoTargetForPrisonerRelatives.label: Mark relatives of prisoners from raids as "No Target" automatically
AutoNoTargetForPrisonerRelatives.description: By default, only pawns with positive relations with colonists are marked as "No Target". When enabled, this setting extends the marking to those with positive relations with prisoners from raids.

DefaultNoTargetMarkTtl.label: Default TTL for "No Target" mark
DefaultNoTargetMarkTtl.description: Specifies the default time-to-live (TTL) in hours for the "No Target" mark when applied via the gizmo. Set to 0 for permanent mark.
